title: Roast cod with sprouting broccoli and sprouts

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Everything here is plain whole food: potatoes, veg, cod, garlic, capers, lemon, oil and chilli flakes.

supermarket.reason: Cod fillets, purple sprouting broccoli, sprouts, potatoes and capers are all everyday Tesco items in late January.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a knife, board and one large roasting tray, and the technique is simple staged roasting.

works.reason: The sliced garlic goes in with the sprouts and roasts for 22 to 25 minutes at 220°C, so it is likely to scorch and turn bitter; adding whole bashed cloves, or adding the garlic with the broccoli, would fix it.

honest_times.reason: Twenty minutes is realistic for halving the potatoes and sprouts, slicing the garlic, trimming the broccoli and zesting the lemon, and 20 + 10 + 15 minutes of roasting matches the 45 minutes printed.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed item is used in the steps, including the lemon as zest and juice, the names match their ids, and nothing unlisted appears.

seasonal_feel.reason: A hot roast traybake suits late January, and the purple sprouting broccoli is a main vegetable roasted alongside the cod, not a garnish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear British English that a beginner could follow.

hearty_healthy.reason: Fish, potatoes and two green vegetables make a balanced, filling family dinner.
